name: grid-layout-accordion

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows one answer open in each column with the rest closed, so the two-column behaviour reads clearly.

tagline: Two columns of questions, each opening one answer at a time.
summary: An FAQ built as two side-by-side columns of collapsible question rows. Opening a row reveals its answer and closes the other open row in that column, so each side keeps one answer visible.
appearance: Two narrow columns of dark rounded question bars on a near-black page, each row ending in a small chevron. The open row turns pale grey and its answer text unfolds beneath it; closed rows stay dark with muted white labels.
behaviour: Clicking a question expands its answer with a quick height animation and turns the row pale. Only one row stays open per column, so opening another closes the previous one, and the two columns work independently.
demo_content: Six questions about UI components, such as What is a UI component? and UI Component Traits.
search_phrases: questions that expand side by side
click a question to reveal answer
use_when: You have many short FAQ questions and want them all visible at once without a long single-column scroll.
avoid_when: Only one answer stays open per column, so two answers in the same column cannot be compared.
customise: Questions, answers and which item starts open are written into the JSX per column; the two-column split is a grid class. Styling comes from the shared accordion pieces.
weight_why: A dozen text rows with one height transition when a row opens.

a11y.note: Questions look clickable, but the header markup is not shown and no focus styling is visible.

issues: The chevron keeps pointing down when a row opens, so the state shows only through the pale fill.
Frame 5 catches two left-column answers open during a transition, which reads as a glitch.
polish_why: Clean two-column layout; the flat dark rows and static chevrons keep it plain.
